verses.original: וְהִתְנַבִּ֞י חַגַּ֣י נְבִיאָה וּזְכַרְיָ֤ה בַר־ עִדּוֹא֙ נְבִיאַיָּא עַל־ יְה֣וּדָיֵ֔א דִּ֥י בִיה֖וּד וּבִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּשֻׁ֛ם אֱלָ֥הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֲלֵיהֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·nab·bî ḥag·gay nə·ḇī·ʾå̄h ū·zə·ḵar·yāh ḇar- ‘id·dō·w nə·ḇī·ʾay·yå̄ ‘al- yə·hū·ḏā·yê dî ḇî·hūḏ ū·ḇî·rū·šə·lem bə·šum ’ĕ·lāh yiś·rā·’êl ‘ă·lê·hō·wn
verses.literal: Later, the prophets Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel who was over them
verses.literalPt: E OS profetas Ageu e Zacarias, filho de Ido, profetizaram aos judeus que estavam em Judá, e em Jerusalém; em nome do Deus de Israel lhes profetizaram.

verses.original: בֵּאדַ֡יִן קָ֠מוּ זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בַּר־ שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְיֵשׁ֣וּעַ בַּר־ יֽוֹצָדָ֔ק וְשָׁרִ֣יו לְמִבְנֵ֔א בֵּ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירֽוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וְעִמְּה֛וֹן נְבִיאַיָּא דִֽי־ אֱלָהָ֖א מְסָעֲדִ֥ין לְהֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: bê·ḏa·yin qā·mū zə·rub·bā·ḇel bar- šə·’al·tî·’êl wə·yê·šū·a‘ bar- yō·w·ṣā·ḏāq wə·šā·rîw lə·miḇ·nê bêṯ ’ĕ·lā·hā dî ḇî·rū·šə·lem wə·‘im·mə·hō·wn nə·ḇī·ʾay·yå̄ ḏî- ’ĕ·lā·hā mə·sā·‘ă·ḏîn lə·hō·wn
verses.literal: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak rose up and began to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem And the prophets . . . of God were with them helping them
verses.literalPt: Então se levantaram Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, e Jesuá, filho de Jozadaque, e começaram a edificar a casa de Deus, que está em Jerusalém; e com eles os profetas de Deus, que os ajudavam.

verses.original: בֵּהּ־ זִמְנָא֩ אֲתָ֨א עֲלֵיה֜וֹן תַּ֠תְּנַי פַּחַ֧ת עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֛ה וּשְׁתַ֥ר בּוֹזְנַ֖י וּכְנָוָתְה֑וֹן וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לְהֹ֔ם מַן־ שָׂ֨ם לְכֹ֜ם טְעֵ֗ם בַּיְתָ֤א דְנָה֙ לִבְּנֵ֔א וְאֻשַּׁרְנָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לְשַׁכְלָלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bêh- zim·nā ’ă·ṯā ‘ă·lê·hō·wn tat·tə·nay pa·ḥaṯ ‘ă·ḇar- na·hă·rāh ū·šə·ṯar bō·wz·nay ū·ḵə·nā·wā·ṯə·hō·wn wə·ḵên ’ā·mə·rîn lə·hōm man- śām lə·ḵōm ṭə·‘êm bay·ṯā ḏə·nāh lib·bə·nê wə·’uš·šar·nā ḏə·nāh lə·šaḵ·lā·lāh
verses.literal: At that time Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates Shethar-bozenai and their associates . . . went to the Jews and asked Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure
verses.literalPt: Naquele tempo vieram a eles Tatenai, governador dalém do rio, e Setar-Bozenai, e os seus companheiros, e disseram-lhes assim: Quem vos deu ordem para reedificardes esta casa, e restaurardes este muro?

verses.original: אֱדַ֥יִן כְּנֵ֖מָא אֲמַ֣רְנָא לְּהֹ֑ם מַן־ אִנּוּן֙ שְׁמָהָ֣ת גֻּבְרַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־ דְנָ֥ה בִנְיָנָ֖א בָּנַֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin kə·nê·mā ’ă·mar·nā lə·hōm man- ’in·nūn šə·mā·hāṯ guḇ·ray·yā dî- ḏə·nāh ḇin·yā·nā bā·na·yin
verses.literal: They also . . . asked What are the names of the men who are constructing this building
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhes, mais: E quais são os nomes dos homens que construíram este edifício?

verses.original: וְעֵ֣ין אֱלָהֲהֹ֗ם הֲוָת֙ עַל־ שָׂבֵ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֔א וְלָא־ בַטִּ֣לוּ הִמּ֔וֹ עַד־ טַעְמָ֖א לְדָרְיָ֣וֶשׁ יְהָ֑ךְ וֶאֱדַ֛יִן יְתִיב֥וּן נִשְׁתְּוָנָ֖א עַל־ דְּנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ên ’ĕ·lā·hă·hōm hă·wāṯ ‘al- śā·ḇê yə·hū·ḏā·yê wə·lā- ḇaṭ·ṭi·lū him·mōw ‘aḏ- ṭa‘·mā lə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš yə·hāḵ we·’ĕ·ḏa·yin yə·ṯî·ḇūn niš·tə·wā·nā ‘al- də·nāh
verses.literal: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews so that they were not stopped until a report was sent to Darius and written instructions about this matter were returned
verses.literalPt: Porém os olhos de Deus estavam sobre os anciãos dos judeus, e não os impediram, até que o negócio chegasse a Dario, e viesse resposta por carta sobre isso.

verses.original: פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן אִ֠גַּרְתָּא דִּֽי־ שְׁלַ֞ח תַּתְּנַ֣י׀ פַּחַ֣ת עֲבַֽר־ נַהֲרָ֗ה וּשְׁתַ֤ר בּוֹזְנַי֙ וּכְנָ֣וָתֵ֔הּ אֲפַ֨רְסְכָיֵ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה עַל־ דָּרְיָ֖וֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽא׃
verses.transliteration: par·še·ḡen ’ig·gar·tā dî- šə·laḥ tat·tə·nay pa·ḥaṯ ‘ă·ḇar- na·hă·rāh ū·šə·ṯar bō·wz·nay ū·ḵə·nā·wā·ṯêh ’ă·p̄ar·sə·ḵā·yê dî ba·‘ă·ḇar na·hă·rāh ‘al- dā·rə·yā·weš mal·kā
verses.literal: This is the text of the letter that Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates Shethar-bozenai and their associates the officials . . . in the region . . . sent to King Darius
verses.literalPt: Cópia da carta que Tatenai, o governador dalém do rio, com Setar-Bozenai e os seus companheiros, os afarsaquitas, que estavam dalém do rio, enviaram ao rei Dario.

verses.original: פִּתְגָמָ֖א שְׁלַ֣חוּ עֲל֑וֹהִי וְכִדְנָה֙ כְּתִ֣יב בְּגַוֵּ֔הּ לְדָרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א שְׁלָמָ֥א כֹֽלָּא׃ס
verses.transliteration: piṯ·ḡā·mā šə·la·ḥū ‘ă·lō·w·hî wə·ḵiḏ·nāh kə·ṯîḇ bə·ḡaw·wêh lə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš mal·kā šə·lā·mā ḵōl·lā
verses.literal: The report they sent him read as follows . . . . . . To King Darius All peace
verses.literalPt: Enviaram-lhe uma carta, na qual estava escrito: Toda a paz ao rei Dario.

verses.original: יְדִ֣יעַ׀ לֶהֱוֵ֣א לְמַלְכָּ֗א דִּֽי־ אֲזַ֜לְנָא לִיה֤וּד מְדִֽינְתָּא֙ לְבֵית֙ אֱלָהָ֣א רַבָּ֔א וְה֤וּא מִתְבְּנֵא֙ אֶ֣בֶן גְּלָ֔ל וְאָ֖ע מִתְּשָׂ֣ם בְּכֻתְלַיָּ֑א וַעֲבִ֥ידְתָּא דָ֛ךְ אָסְפַּ֥רְנָא מִתְעַבְדָ֖א וּמַצְלַ֥ח בְּיֶדְהֹֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏî·a‘ le·hĕ·wê lə·mal·kā dî- ’ă·zal·nā lî·hūḏ mə·ḏî·nə·tā lə·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lā·hā rab·bā wə·hū miṯ·bə·nê ’e·ḇen gə·lāl wə·’ā‘ mit·tə·śām bə·ḵuṯ·lay·yā wa·‘ă·ḇî·ḏə·tā ḏāḵ ’ā·sə·par·nā miṯ·‘aḇ·ḏā ū·maṣ·laḥ bə·yeḏ·hōm
verses.literal: Let it be known to the king that we went into the province of Judah to the house of the great God The people are rebuilding it with large stones . . . and placing timbers in the walls This work is being carried out diligently and is prospering in their hands
verses.literalPt: Seja notório ao rei, que nós fomos à província de Judá, à casa do grande Deus, a qual se edifica com grandes pedras, e a madeira já está sendo posta nas paredes; e esta obra vai sendo feita com diligência, e se adianta em suas mãos.

verses.original: אֱדַ֗יִן שְׁאֵ֙לְנָא֙ לְשָׂבַיָּ֣א אִלֵּ֔ךְ כְּנֵ֖מָא אֲמַ֣רְנָא לְּהֹ֑ם מַן־ שָׂ֨ם לְכֹ֜ם טְעֵ֗ם בַּיְתָ֤א דְנָה֙ לְמִבְנְיָ֔ה וְאֻשַּׁרְנָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לְשַׁכְלָלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin šə·’ê·lə·nā lə·śā·ḇay·yā ’il·lêḵ kə·nê·mā ’ă·mar·nā lə·hōm man- śām lə·ḵōm ṭə·‘êm bay·ṯā ḏə·nāh lə·miḇ·nə·yāh wə·’uš·šar·nā ḏə·nāh lə·šaḵ·lā·lāh
verses.literal: So we questioned the . . . elders and asked Who authorized . . . you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure
verses.literalPt: Então perguntamos aos anciãos, e assim lhes dissemos: Quem vos deu ordem para reedificardes esta casa, e restaurardes este muro?

verses.original: וְאַ֧ף שְׁמָהָתְהֹ֛ם שְׁאֵ֥לְנָא לְּהֹ֖ם לְהוֹדָעוּתָ֑ךְ דִּ֛י נִכְתֻּ֥ב שֻׁם־ גֻּבְרַיָּ֖א דִּ֥י בְרָאשֵׁיהֹֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄ šə·mā·hā·ṯə·hōm šə·’ê·lə·nā lə·hōm lə·hō·w·ḏā·‘ū·ṯāḵ dî niḵ·tuḇ šum- guḇ·ray·yā dî ḇə·rā·šê·hōm
verses.literal: We also asked for their names so that we could write down the names of their leaders . . . . . . for your information
verses.literalPt: Além disso, lhes perguntamos também pelos seus nomes, para tos declararmos; para que te pudéssemos escrever os nomes dos homens que entre eles são os chefes.

verses.original: וּכְנֵ֥מָא פִתְגָמָ֖א הֲתִיב֣וּנָא לְמֵמַ֑ר אֲנַ֣חְנָא הִמּ֡וֹ עַבְדוֹהִי֩ דִֽי־ אֱלָ֨הּ שְׁמַיָּ֜א וְאַרְעָ֗א וּבָנַ֤יִן בַּיְתָא֙ דִּֽי־ הֲוָ֨א בְנֵ֜ה מִקַּדְמַ֤ת דְּנָה֙ שְׁנִ֣ין שַׂגִּיאָ֔ן וּמֶ֤לֶךְ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רַ֔ב בְּנָ֖הִי וְשַׁכְלְלֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·nê·mā p̄iṯ·ḡā·mā hă·ṯî·ḇū·nā lə·mê·mar ’ă·naḥ·nā him·mōw ‘aḇ·ḏō·w·hî ḏî- ’ĕ·lāh šə·may·yā wə·’ar·‘ā ū·ḇā·na·yin bay·ṯā dî- hă·wā ḇə·nêh miq·qaḏ·maṯ də·nāh šə·nîn śag·gî·’ān ū·me·leḵ lə·yiś·rā·’êl raḇ bə·nā·hî wə·šaḵ·lə·lêh
verses.literal: And this is the answer they returned . . . We are servants of the God of heaven and earth and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago . . . which a great king of Israel built and completed
verses.literalPt: E esta foi a resposta que nos deram: Nós somos servos do Deus dos céus e da terra, e reedificamos a casa que há muitos anos foi edificada; porque um grande rei de Israel a edificou e a terminou.

verses.original: לָהֵ֗ן מִן־ דִּ֨י הַרְגִּ֤זוּ אֲבָהֳתַ֙נָא֙ לֶאֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א יְהַ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ בְּיַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל כַּסְדָּיָא וּבַיְתָ֤ה דְנָה֙ סַתְרֵ֔הּ וְעַמָּ֖ה הַגְלִ֥י לְבָבֶֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·hên min- dî har·gi·zū ’ă·ḇā·ho·ṯa·nā le·’ĕ·lāh šə·may·yā yə·haḇ him·mōw bə·yaḏ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel kas·då̄·yå̄ ū·ḇay·ṯāh ḏə·nāh saṯ·rêh wə·‘am·māh haḡ·lî lə·ḇā·ḇel
verses.literal: But since . . . our fathers angered the God of heaven He delivered them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon the Chaldean who destroyed this temple and carried away the people to Babylon
verses.literalPt: Mas depois que nossos pais provocaram à ira o Deus dos céus, ele os entregou nas mãos de Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, o caldeu, o qual destruiu esta casa, e transportou o povo para Babilônia.

verses.original: בְּרַם֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֔ה לְכ֥וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א דִּ֣י בָבֶ֑ל כּ֤וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֙ שָׂ֣ם טְעֵ֔ם בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֥א דְנָ֖ה לִבְּנֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ram biš·naṯ ḥă·ḏāh lə·ḵō·w·reš mal·kā dî ḇā·ḇel kō·w·reš mal·kā śām ṭə·‘êm bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḏə·nāh lib·bə·nê
verses.literal: In the first year of his reign however Cyrus king of Babylon - issued a decree to rebuild this house of God
verses.literalPt: Porém, no primeiro ano de Ciro, rei de Babilônia, o rei Ciro deu ordem para que esta casa de Deus se reedificasse.

verses.original: וְ֠אַף מָאנַיָּ֣א דִֽי־ בֵית־ אֱלָהָא֮ דִּ֣י דַהֲבָ֣ה וְכַסְפָּא֒ דִּ֣י נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר הַנְפֵּק֙ מִן־ הֵֽיכְלָא֙ דִּ֣י בִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֔ם וְהֵיבֵ֣ל הִמּ֔וֹ לְהֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י בָבֶ֑ל הַנְפֵּ֨ק הִמּ֜וֹ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗א מִן־ הֵֽיכְלָא֙ דִּ֣י בָבֶ֔ל וִיהִ֙יבוּ֙ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֣ר שְׁמֵ֔הּ דִּ֥י פֶחָ֖ה שָׂמֵֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄ mā·nay·yā ḏî- ḇêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā dî ḏa·hă·ḇāh wə·ḵas·pā dî nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar han·pêq min- hê·ḵə·lā dî ḇî·rū·šə·lem wə·hê·ḇêl him·mōw lə·hê·ḵə·lā dî ḇā·ḇel han·pêq him·mōw kō·w·reš mal·kā min- hê·ḵə·lā dî ḇā·ḇel wî·hî·ḇū lə·šê·šə·baṣ·ṣar šə·mêh dî p̄e·ḥāh śā·mêh
verses.literal: He also removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles belonging to the house of God which Nebuchadnezzar had taken and carried there . . . . . . from the temple in Jerusalem King Cyrus gave these articles to a man named . . . Sheshbazzar whom he appointed governor
verses.literalPt: E até os utensílios de ouro e prata, da casa de Deus, que Nabucodonosor tomou do templo que estava em Jerusalém e os levou para o templo de Babilônia, o rei Ciro os tirou do templo de Babilônia, e foram dados a um homem cujo nome era Sesbazar, a quem nomeou governador.

verses.original: וַאֲמַר־ לֵ֓הּ׀ אֵלֶּה מָֽאנַיָּ֔א שֵׂ֚א אֵֽזֶל־ אֲחֵ֣ת הִמּ֔וֹ בְּהֵיכְלָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּבֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א יִתְבְּנֵ֥א עַל־ אַתְרֵֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar- lêh ʾēl·lɛh mā·nay·yā śē ’ê·zel- ’ă·ḥêṯ him·mōw bə·hê·ḵə·lā dî ḇî·rū·šə·lem ū·ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lā·hā yiṯ·bə·nê ‘al- ’aṯ·rêh
verses.literal: and instructed Take . . . these articles put them in the temple . . . in Jerusalem and let the house of God be rebuilt on its original site
verses.literalPt: E disse-lhe: Toma estes utensílios, vai e leva-os ao templo que está em Jerusalém, e faze reedificar a casa de Deus, no seu lugar.

verses.original: אֱדַ֙יִן֙ שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֣ר דֵּ֔ךְ אֲתָ֗א יְהַ֧ב אֻשַּׁיָּ֛א דִּי־ בֵ֥ית אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּמִן־ אֱדַ֧יִן וְעַד־ כְּעַ֛ן מִתְבְּנֵ֖א וְלָ֥א שְׁלִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·ḏa·yin šê·šə·baṣ·ṣar dêḵ ’ă·ṯā yə·haḇ ’uš·šay·yā dî- ḇêṯ ’ĕ·lā·hā dî ḇî·rū·šə·lem ū·min- ’ĕ·ḏa·yin wə·‘aḏ- kə·‘an miṯ·bə·nê wə·lā šə·lim
verses.literal: So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem and from that time until now it has been under construction but it has not yet been completed
verses.literalPt: Então veio este Sesbazar, e pôs os fundamentos da casa de Deus, que está em Jerusalém e desde então para cá se está reedificando, e ainda não está acabada.

verses.original: וּכְעַ֞ן הֵ֧ן עַל־ מַלְכָּ֣א טָ֗ב יִ֠תְבַּקַּר בְּבֵ֨ית גִּנְזַיָּ֜א דִּי־ מַלְכָּ֣א תַמָּה֮ דִּ֣י בְּבָבֶל֒ הֵ֣ן אִיתַ֗י דִּֽי־ מִן־ כּ֤וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְמִבְנֵ֛א בֵּית־ אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ בִּירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם וּרְע֥וּת מַלְכָּ֛א עַל־ דְּנָ֖ה יִשְׁלַ֥ח עֲלֶֽינָא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·‘an hên ‘al- mal·kā ṭāḇ yiṯ·baq·qar bə·ḇêṯ gin·zay·yā dî- mal·kā ṯam·māh dî bə·ḇā·ḇel hên ’î·ṯay dî- min- kō·w·reš mal·kā śîm ṭə·‘êm lə·miḇ·nê bêṯ- ’ĕ·lā·hā ḏêḵ bî·rū·šə·lem ū·rə·‘ūṯ mal·kā ‘al- də·nāh yiš·laḥ ‘ă·le·nā
verses.literal: Now, therefore, if it pleases the king let a search be made of the royal . . . . . . archives . . . in Babylon to see if . . . . . . King Cyrus did indeed issue a decree to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem Then let the king send us his decision in this matter
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, se parece bem ao rei, busque-se na casa dos tesouros do rei, que está em Babilônia, se é verdade que se deu uma ordem pelo rei Ciro para reedificar esta casa de Deus em Jerusalém; e sobre isto nos faça saber a vontade do rei.
